matterTypes.DOC-030 matters type: The lab type for the create dialog. Form (in order): Title, Matter type (pinned); Description, Department, Priority, Risk and Needed by On intake form; Region a record Row; DOC-030 matters required note Required for creation; DOC-030 matters optional note, DOC-030 matters Entity and DOC-030 matters person On intake form. Templates: alpha, beta, gamma playbooks.
matterTypes.DOC-030 matters retype: Built-in Rows as a new type gets them (only Description On intake form), plus DOC-030 matters required note and DOC-030 matters retype number Required for creation. Template: undrawn defaults playbook (Priority High, Risk Low).
matterTypes.DOC-030 matters department required: Description On intake form and Department Required for creation; no Fields.

fixtures.organizationSettingsTouched: Each direct-create step added one Matter Document type named DOC-030 matters paper <stamp> <role> through the Administrator API and archived it at the end of the same step. Development runs left two of them live for about ten minutes before they were archived; all seven are archived. The gamma template is archived and restored inside its step.

productBugs.summary: The Set parent and Add related Matter search does not accept the M- prefix. Typing "M-103" lists 0 candidates; typing "103" lists M-103. The API treats only a bare number as a number (matter-relations/routes.ts relation-candidates).
productBugs.reproduction: On a Matter, Related Matters > Set parent, type the reference of another reachable Matter as shown on its header (for example M-103). No candidate appears. Type the digits only and it appears.

productBugs.summary: A bare-number search does not rank the exact Matter number first. Candidates are ordered by number and capped at 20, and titles that contain the digits also match, so the Matter with that number can fall outside the list.
productBugs.reproduction: Development run 1790332254512: on M-78, Set parent, typed "79". More than 20 lower-numbered Matters had titles containing 79 (walkthrough stamps), and M-79 was not listed within 30 seconds. The title search found it.

notes: Development runs 1790330932552, 1790331402866 and 1790332254512 used earlier versions of the scripts; their steps were replaced by the final run 1790333890346. Failures in them were script selector errors, the shared magic-link rate limit (3 per address and 30 per client address in 15 minutes, shared by every agent on 127.0.0.1) and the relation search ranking listed under productBugs.

The Business User session is signed in once per run from a fresh magic link read from Mailpit; the script waits a minute on each 429. BU_STATE keeps that context in the session scratchpad, outside docs/, so reruns do not spend the shared budget.
Upload and comment failures are browser-route stand-ins (route.abort) for network failures.
